question: What happens to oligodendrocytes when their mitochondrial DNA breaks?
question_long: What happens to oligodendrocytes, and to the tissue around them, when double-strand breaks are induced in their mitochondrial DNA, and does it resemble multiple sclerosis?
intro: PlpTA:mtPst1 mice, 12 brain sections (control / mtDSB, induced at P21 or P60, 3 mice each) on Xenium 5k, ~980k cells, all 42 days after induction. The mouse is the replicate: models never see the mouse they score, and responders are compared with controls by exact permutation.
